QuestInfo.name: Stop the Temple Raid
QuestInfo.0: #p2410008# awoke to find the other knights worked into a fervor. With his two recent successes, he couldn't see why there would be such an uproar. Someone must know what's happening...
QuestInfo.1: The decision to raid the #m321000600# bewildered #p2410008#, especially when he was told to stay put. #p2410008# worried that this could be a trap, or that someone was on to him.
QuestInfo.2: #p2410008# decided that he could not afford to let the other Shadow Knights reach the #m321000600# before he had a chance to awaken the girl. His choice would put him face to face with the only family he's ever known.
